title:
This epic is used to update primary and secondary buttons on Alert Detail Tab Panel.
1. If the {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert#currentState} is `Open`, then
  1.a: Enable primary button displayed as `Add to Case`.
  1.b: Show secondary button as `Close Alert`.

2. If the {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert#currentState} is `Closed`, then
  2.a: Disable primary button.
  2.b: Show secondary button as `Reopen Alert`.
name: UiSdlEpicUpdateAlertDetailTabPanelButtons
